smaller_controls.intended_mating_exclusion: Narrow locking stem inside its boss/bore; rocker axle bearings. Exterior drums/shells are checked.

limitations: Targeted continuous swept AABBs prove separation of named actuator/stage solids; not every instrument pair.
Mating fixed parts, sleeve/spindle guidance and thread interfaces are intentional assembly engagement.
Contact coverage checks metal grip vertices against the union of collision cylinders; ink is excluded.
Camera cable is a driven visual mesh, without cable-contact or strain dynamics.
